Wheelchair transportation

Accessible transportation arranged around your wheelchair and assistance needs.

Planning your trip

Include your wheelchair type, pickup access and any assistance requirements. The team must confirm vehicle compatibility and pickup arrangements before accepting the ride.

What details are needed for wheelchair transportation?

Share your wheelchair type, pickup and destination addresses, appointment time and access conditions so the team can check suitability.

UNDERSTAND YOUR RIDE

Who this is for

For passengers whose trip requires wheelchair access and a vehicle compatible with their chair and assistance needs.

How the journey is planned

Wheelchair transportation planning covers more than vehicle space. The team needs to review the chair, boarding access and how the wheelchair and passenger will be secured. A power chair, scooter, wider chair or difficult entrance needs advance discussion; suitability is confirmed for the individual trip.

What we plan with you

  • Review of chair and vehicle compatibility
  • Access planning at pickup and destination
  • Boarding and securement arrangements

Have these details ready

  • Manual chair, power chair or scooter type
  • Chair dimensions and combined weight if requested
  • Ramps, elevators, stairs and doorway access

Questions about this service

Can I stay in my wheelchair during the ride?

Tell the team that you need to remain seated in your chair. They must confirm the vehicle, chair compatibility and appropriate securement before accepting the trip.

Can the driver carry a wheelchair up stairs?

Do not assume stair carrying or lifting is included. Describe every step and access barrier in advance so the team can review an appropriate arrangement.

Our team confirms pickup timing, vehicle suitability, assistance and return arrangements before accepting a ride.

Sources for general planning guidance
  • Dream Care Rides: NEMT guide
  • Call The Care: Fort Worth transportation

Details to have ready

  • Wheelchair type and access requirements
  • Pickup and destination entrance details
  • Assistance needs and required arrival

How to arrange a ride

Choose wheelchair transportation and prepare the trip details. The transportation team must review your request, vehicle suitability and availability before confirming pickup. A calendar appointment or prepared request alone does not confirm transportation.
